title: "rungar scale-sets resume"
description: "Have a paused scale set take jobs again"
---

Have a paused scale set take jobs again: its min_runners are created at once, and the jobs waiting for it are taken within a minute, as GitHub next hears it has room. It lasts until the daemon restarts, which goes back to what the configuration says: set paused there to make it last.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar scale-sets resume NAME
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
